summary: Parked residential kerb lined with apartment blocks 11-14 m away on both sides.

best_section.where: South kerb of Macquarie Street between Macquarie Manor and Roseville

drivers.seclusion: Apartment blocks 14 m behind and 11 m beyond on the same side, with more flats opposite; densely built.
drivers.access_and_room: Parallel kerb where other cars park; room for a van in the line.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street with only local traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park on both sides, so a van blends in, but residents are close.

flags: Apartments 11-14 m away on own side
Low-lying: about 4.6 m elevation, Brisbane River 191 m away
Loading zones and traffic area signs near the west end
sun_shade: Mixed tree canopy over the kerb, strongest from the south side; open from the north.
